## F04.trust-prompt — Trust prompt

Definition: The first-run or per-folder trust decision.

A teammate gets an agent definition's tools and instructions only if you've trusted the folder the agent file is in; trusting a parent folder doesn't count. ## F04.config-scope-precedence — Config scope and precedence

Definition: Where permission rules live and which scope wins.
- claude-code [supported, unverified] `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` makes managed settings the only settings source of permission rules. By default Claude Code reads only the highest-ranked managed source you deliver. `resolveSettings()` resolves the effective settings for a directory using the same merge engine as the CLI, without spawning the CLI. | ev: E-claude-code-00124, E-claude-code-00014, E-claude-code-00939
- codex-cli [supported, verified] User-level config lives at ~/.codex/config.toml; a .codex/config.toml in a repo or subfolder scopes settings to that project. For local execution, MDM and legacy managed-device requirements take precedence over Agent Security, which takes precedence over the device's system requirements file. Approval policy and web search stay in Global and cannot be overridden by an environment. | ev: E-codex-cli-00450, E-codex-cli-00914, E-codex-cli-01255
- copilot-cli [supported, verified] --deny-tool takes precedence over --allow-all-tools and --allow-tool, and permission rules that deny a tool take precedence over automatic or saved approvals. Approvals for the current location are saved to permissions-config.json in the configuration directory (by default ~/.copilot/permissions-config.json); only the first applicable configuration directory is used. | ev: E-copilot-cli-00044, E-copilot-cli-00016, E-copilot-cli-00490, E-copilot-cli-01188
- copilot-vscode [supported, unverified] For a local Agent Host, Workspace sandbox settings take precedence over User settings, followed by product defaults. For most managed settings, the highest-precedence channel's value wins per key. A Copilot managed setting takes precedence over a VS Code device policy, and values are not merged. A policy value overrides the setting at default, user and workspace level. | ev: E-copilot-vscode-00770, E-copilot-vscode-01041, E-copilot-vscode-01045, E-copilot-vscode-02890
- cursor [supported, unverified] Auto-review reads permissions.json from two locations. When a Cursor policy is specified through device management solutions, its value overrides the corresponding Cursor setting on users' devices. Cursor resolves the effective MCP allowlist in an ordered sequence. | ev: E-cursor-00084, E-cursor-00539, E-cursor-00604
- gemini-cli [partial, verified] Settings are merged from four files, with a precedence order for single-value settings. Gemini CLI uses JSON settings files for persistent configuration. The policy engine applies the highest-priority rule that matches the tool call. | limit: E-gemini-cli-02082 says configuration is stored in two settings.json files; E-gemini-cli-00606 and E-gemini-cli-01494 say there are four settings files that are merged. The quotes do not reconcile the counts. | ev: E-gemini-cli-01494, E-gemini-cli-00606, E-gemini-cli-02082, E-gemini-cli-00805
- grok-build [supported, unverified] Permission rules live in the `[permission]` section, which is project-scoped and user-scoped; evaluation order is deny › ask › allow. Project configs are limited to MCP servers, plugins, and permission rules. Configuration loads from five layers, lowest to highest priority. Default permission mode: user config or managed/requirements, not project `.grok/config.toml`. | ev: E-grok-build-00201, E-grok-build-00060, E-grok-build-00025, E-grok-build-00235
- grok-bot [partial, verified] Auto-review rules are added under Settings → General → Auto-review; personal rules are stored on each desktop. Admins can add team Auto-review rules (Enterprise only) that apply to every member's Bots and show as locked rows in member settings. Ask first wins if two rules conflict; if the switch says Required by your admin, it cannot be turned off. | limit: Admins can add team Auto-review rules. Enterprise only. | ev: E-grok-bot-00020, E-grok-bot-00077, E-grok-bot-00082, E-grok-bot-00981
